delivery_binding.claim_ceiling: Successful request receipt binds visible read bytes; source validation, final selection and semantic use require separate evidence. Archives, tokenizer-only captures and unsuccessful dispatches are not confirmed delivery.

selection.summary: Terminal candidate review for #1971 (view README of current branch). h2 (pkg/cmd/repo/view/http.go@base:1-53) shows RepositoryReadme building getReadmePath(repo, branch) with ?ref=<branch> when a branch is set, 404→NotFoundError, and base64-decoded content. h0 (view.go@base:1-100) defines ViewOptions with RepoArg/Branch, --branch flag, and RepoArg resolution. h3 (view.go@base:100-197) covers the remainder of viewRun, relevant to wiring the branch into the readme fetch for `gh repo view .`. These base observations are the useful context for assessing the branch-scoped readme viewing fix.

native_export.selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles bound to exact successful request/response, then unchanged native source projection and export; not archive union.

sidecar.claim_ceiling: Confirmed delivery and declared final selection only; neither proves semantic use.

source_projection.claim_ceiling: Only exact unchanged source lines map to base coordinates. Changed/inserted lines receive no base-context credit.
